answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The zephyr is the quoted measurement, the nadir the group it forms, and the sonnet the voice that group is worth; the zephyr and the nadir collapse a farm, while only a fresh sonnet of hardware escapes the grouping.
